_readme: S402 SkyToyon, 2026-10-17. Page read 38998089408 found Santiago Canyon's eLumen host serving its 2025-2026 catalog (slug 'catalog', header '2025-2026 Catalog') and West Valley's 2026-2027 catalog as HTML on westvalley.edu, but the reader's 40-link cap hid Santiago Canyon's 'Catalog Archives' and 'Printer Friendly Catalog (PDF)' links and West Valley's 'Download 2026-2027 Catalog'. The harvest reads a college's current catalog, never one a year behind (Palo Verde, S387). Two loads, no model call, links narrowed to the ones the cap hid.
